parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: RunType
parameters.description:
The execution type. Valid values:

*   synchronous
*   asynchronous (not supported)

parameters.name: SecretArn
parameters.description:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the access credential for the created Data API account. You can call the CreateSecret operation to create an access credential.

>  To call the ExecuteStatement operation as a Resource Access Management (RAM) user, the RAM user must have the permissions to call the UseSecret or GetSecretValue operation on the ARN of the access credential.

parameters.name: Sql
parameters.description: The SQL statements that you want to execute.

parameters.name: StatementName
parameters.description: The name of the set of SQL statements that you want to execute. This parameter takes effect when the RunType parameter is set to asynchronous.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb execute-statement --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --workspace-id gp-ws-00000 --rag-workspace-collection Collection=mycollection Namespace=mynamespace --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database adbtest --run-type synchronous --statement-name test --sql select_0_from_table1 --sqls set_idle_in_transaction_session_timeout_=_300000 --parameters myvalue --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb ExecuteStatement --region cn-hangzhou --SecretArn 'acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ' --StatementName test --Sqls '["set_idle_in_transaction_session_timeout_=_300000"]' --Parameters '["myvalue"]' --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --WorkspaceId 'gp-ws-00000' --Database adbtest --RunType synchronous --RagWorkspaceCollection '{"Collection":"mycollection","Namespace":"mynamespace"}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Sql select_0_from_table1
